summary: Iter3 re-verify of MentionInput web fix. PASS end-to-end. Signed in as reese@teebox.demo, opened first Feed round, typed '@Jo' in post-comment-input → mention-suggestions dropdown appeared with Jordan Kim (mention-suggest-069b5753-...). Tapping the suggestion inserted '@Jordan_Kim ' into the input with NO red error overlay (previous setNativeProps crash is gone). Appended ' great round!' and tapped post-comment-send: new comment 'Reese Callahan · @Jordan_Kim great round!' appeared in the thread, @Jordan_Kim rendered in brand green (rgb(21,128,61) — colors.brandPrimary), and comment count on the round incremented 1 → 2. Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, pre-existing from iter2.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: MentionInput.tsx now correctly gates caret placement: web uses declarative `selection` state prop cleared on next tick; native still uses guarded setNativeProps in try/catch. Clean fix, no residual imperative calls on web.
PostDetail onSubmit already updates local comments list and increments round.comment_count optimistically — consistent with the observed 1 → 2 update.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the mention → submit → highlighted render path

seed_data_creation: None — used existing auto-seeded reese@teebox.demo + jordan@teebox.demo. One extra comment '@Jordan_Kim great round!' was added to the first feed round during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter2 blocker is fixed. MentionInput on web now uses declarative selection prop (no setNativeProps on web). Full mention flow (dropdown → pick → insert → submit → styled render → count increment) works on Expo web preview.
rca_of_issue: Fixed in MentionInput.tsx: on Platform.OS === 'web', setSelection({start,end}) is used to control TextInput's selection prop, then cleared to undefined on next tick so it does not fight user typing. On native, the original inputRef.current?.setNativeProps?.({selection}) call is preserved (guarded try/catch). This eliminates the 'setNativeProps is not a function' throw on React Native Web and unblocks the comment submit path.
